name: PrEP Assistance Program (PrEP-AP)
description: California's PrEP Assistance Program makes HIV prevention medication accessible to residents who might not otherwise afford it, covering the cost of PrEP medication, doctor visits, and lab tests.
fullDescription: California's PrEP Assistance Program makes HIV prevention medication accessible to residents who might not otherwise afford it, covering the cost of PrEP medication, doctor visits, and lab tests.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free PrEP medication (Truvada, Descovy, or generic)
- Coverage for doctor visits and HIV testing
- Lab work costs covered
- Available to residents with income under 600% FPL
- Minors ages 12-17 and adults with confidentiality concerns can enroll
- PrEP-AP Immediate Access: One free month of PrEP for anyone
- Available regardless of immigration status (not subject to Public Charge)
- Helps uninsured and insured individuals
howToGetIt: Enroll at a PrEP-AP enrollment site, using the list of acceptable eligibility documents (proof of California residency and income). If uninsured, a minor, or concerned about confidentiality, see a provider in the PrEP-AP Clinical Provider Network; if insured, see a provider in your health plan. Anyone can get one free month by creating an account and enrolling in PrEP-AP Immediate Access.
keywords: PrEP, HIV prevention, Truvada, Descovy, free medication, HIV test, pre-exposure prophylaxis, LGBTQ, uninsured, undocumented
